goal: NET logging review: structured messages, levels and sensitive data in log scopes.
use: NET logging review: structured messages, levels and sensitive data in log scopes. Use when a .NET service writes logs.

steps.note: List the log calls. Find the logger and each message template.
Check templates. Flag string interpolation instead of structured placeholders.
Check levels. Flag errors logged as information and noise logged as errors.
Check sensitive data. Flag personal data or tokens in messages or scopes.
Report. Each call with file and line, the problem and the fix.
